excerpt: There's no dancefloor here, no need to lock into a groove or deliver a drop. Instead, Paap is chasing sound for sound's sake, pushing stereo dynamics, distorting drum loops until they fray, stretching reverbs until they fill entire rooms. Walkman is his first solo album in over 20 years, a 90-minute, 20-track journey released on STOOR in 2026.

OS ZA CR AA NC stands as an immense body of experimental electronic excavation — a sprawling surge of shattered atmospheres, industrial textures, and glitch-laden compositions. Özcan Saraç's work pushes the boundaries of electronic music with dense, layered sound design.

Exploraciones Al Vacio works because it refuses to play nice. The field recordings, the layered textures, and unpredictable structures create an immersive sonic experience that rewards careful listening.
What begins as mechanical sound manipulation gradually transforms into drum-heavy recollections from another era entirely. A surreal passage through sound that blends the mechanical and the melodic.

What makes Chambers work is that it doesn't feel like an experiment for the sake of it. The processing serves the music, not the other way around — a sign of artistic maturity in electronic composition.
Shadow Tactics maintains a focus on structure and texture — beats splinter, surfaces scrape, and each element is placed with intent. It's a record that rewards close attention.
Octavcat balances playful experimentation with precise execution, offering moments of introspection, energy, and sonic surprise across this latest release.
Unit Shifter has been quietly building a catalog that spans the breadth of contemporary electronic music, and this compilation brings together artists who embody that ethos of exploration.
These tracks form a succinct pairing, orbiting just beyond cerebral breakbeat fragments and electronic flickers — an intense sonic link that stretches rhythm toward its outer limits.
